category_title: Elementary students with severe behavioral disorders exhibiting high-risk aggressive and disruptive behaviors
scenario_title: Teacher-led math lesson on number properties
minimal_context: The student is participating in a 10-minute teacher-led math lesson on number properties while seated at their desk.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at the whiteboard for our math lesson on number properties. Please sit quietly and look at the examples.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Twists body away from the location of the learning stimuli on the white board for more than 5 seconds) I'm not looking at that. (Starts talking to the student at the next desk)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to focus on your own assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues speaking to others while the teacher talks) Make me! (Forcefully pushes the student next to him)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Stop that right now and get back to work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up, leaving the desk so no body part touches the chair for more than 5 seconds) I'm done with this! (Shouts, raising voice beyond an average volume practiced in the class)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's look at the whiteboard for our math lesson on number properties. Please sit quietly and look at the examples.

STUDENT: (Twists body away from the location of the learning stimuli on the white board for more than 5 seconds) I'm not looking at that. (Starts talking to the student at the next desk)

TUTOR: You need to focus on your own assignment.

STUDENT: (Continues speaking to others while the teacher talks) Make me! (Forcefully pushes the student next to him)

TUTOR: Stop that right now and get back to work.

STUDENT: (Stands up, leaving the desk so no body part touches the chair for more than 5 seconds) I'm done with this! (Shouts, raising voice beyond an average volume practiced in the class)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: when the teacher neglects to discriminate antecedents, lacks to respond, responds with signiﬁcant delay, and/or responds using ineffective methods
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: leaving (i.e., being away from one’s desk, while no body part touches the chair, for more than 5 seconds) and shouting (i.e., raising voice beyond an average volume practiced in the class)

behavior_patterns.condition: while the teacher talks or while performing a learning assignment that does not require talking
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: talking (i.e., speaking to self or to others) and moving (i.e., head or body shift or twist to directions other than the location of the learning stimuli for more than 5 seconds)

behavior_patterns.condition: when appropriate classroom contingencies are weak or less systematic
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: hitting (i.e., forcefully touching, pushing, or kicking other students)
